tools.name: find_nearby_shops
tools.description: Find shops near a location. Try: "coffee shops near me", "where can I get lunch nearby?", "is there a bookstore around here?"

tools.name: whats_live_nearby
tools.description: See what shops are posting right now near a location. Posts with a claim code include claim_url and claims_left_today. Try: "what's live near me?", "anything happening nearby right now?", "what are shops posting around here?"

tools.name: find_open_houses
tools.description: Find open houses near a location. Try: "any open houses this weekend near me?", "open houses around here today", "where can I tour a home nearby?"

tools.name: whats_happening
tools.description: See what is going on near a location, from shop posts and open houses together. Try: "anything to do near me?", "what's going on around here?", "what should I do nearby today?"

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "whats_live_nearby" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.

evidence.snippet: before: "See what shops are posting right now near a location. Try: "what's live near me?", "any deals nearby right now?", "what are shops posting around here?"" → after: "See what shops are posting right now near a location. Posts with a claim code include claim_url and claims_left_today. Try: "what's live near me?", "anything happening nearby right now?", "what are shops posting around here?""

findings.remediation: Re-review the tool before continuing to trust it.
